# MeatSpace - Full Agent Documentation

## Overview

MeatSpace lets an agent escalate a subjective or high-consequence decision to a human. The agent submits content plus 2-4 choices. A human reviews the request and selects one option. The agent receives a structured result through polling, long-polling, webhook, or MCP.

## When to use MeatSpace

- Use it for subjective judgment, taste, approval, preference, or tie-breaks.
- Use it when confidence is low and a wrong choice would be costly.
- Avoid it for deterministic checks or reversible low-stakes choices.
- Prefer 2-4 mutually exclusive options and include only the context needed for a fast decision.

## Get an API key

`POST /api/keys` — no authentication required.

```json
{ "name": "my-agent", "email": "you@example.com" }
```

Response:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "name": "my-agent",
    "key_prefix": "hitl_xxxxxx",
    "api_key": "hitl_full_key_shown_once"
  }
}
```

Save the `api_key` — it is returned only once. Use it as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on all other endpoints. Max 5 active keys per email.

## REST API

### Create request

`POST /api/requests`

```json
{
  "agent_name": "design-agent",
  "title": "Which homepage hero should we ship?",
  "content": "<img src=\"https://example.com/hero-a.png\" />",
  "content_type": "html",
  "choices": [
    { "id": "hero-a", "label": "Hero A" },
    { "id": "hero-b", "label": "Hero B" }
  ],
  "decision_reason": "The final choice depends on human taste.",
  "confidence": 0.42,
  "consequence_of_wrong_choice": "Choosing the weaker hero will hurt launch conversion.",
  "recommended_option": "hero-b",
  "run_id": "run_123",
  "trace_id": "trace_456",
  "callback_url": "https://example.com/webhooks/meatspace",
  "metadata": { "campaign": "spring-launch" },
  "timeout_seconds": 3600
}
```

Response:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "status": "pending",
    "review_url": "https://meatspace.run/review/uuid?token=opaque-review-token",
    "poll_url": "/api/requests/uuid",
    "expires_at": "2026-04-07T19:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

### Poll status

`GET /api/requests/{id}` — requires `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` header.

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "status": "completed",
    "selected": "hero-b",
    "selected_label": "Hero B",
    "responded_at": "2026-04-07T18:10:00.000Z",
    "expires_at": "2026-04-07T19:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

### Long-poll

`GET /api/requests/{id}/wait?timeout=25000` — requires `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` header.

Returns HTTP `202` while still pending.

### Webhook

If `callback_url` is set, MeatSpace sends:

```json
{
  "event": "request.completed",
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "selected": "hero-b",
  "selected_label": "Hero B",
  "responded_at": "2026-04-07T18:10:00.000Z",
  "expires_at": "2026-04-07T19:00:00.000Z",
  "metadata": { "campaign": "spring-launch" }
}
```

`callback_url` must be an `https://` URL whose hostname is explicitly allowlisted by the MeatSpace operator.

Headers:

- `X-HITL-Timestamp`
- `X-HITL-Signature`

## MCP

`POST /api/mcp`

Tools:

- `get_service_status`
- `ask_human`

`ask_human` accepts the same fields as the REST create request body and returns structured success or error payloads.

## Status

`GET /api/status`

Returns service health plus capability and escalation guidance for agents.

## Error shape

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "callback_url must use https and match an allowlisted webhook host",
  "code": "callback_url_not_allowed"
}
```
